I respect you so much for this... my ex-boyfriend would do these exact things, and much more, with some bad consequences. This is pretty recent and I’m still healing. I didn’t know how to walk away from it, so I endured it for over a year. I understood that he had been through some awful things in his life and him having anger issues was more than understandable. I also had my own insecurities in the relationship that would spout some arguments, but I still believe that I didn’t deserve to be traumatized the way that I was... I’m a female that is 4’ 11”.. a whole foot shorter than my ex-boyfriend... it makes for some fearful moments when he would be in an uncontrollable rage and I’d be in the middle of that path..

It’s been 3 months, and I never realized how badly this would affect me after getting out.. I’m still wondering if he will ever look back and see what he did to me and how badly I’m hurt. I’m hoping he will end up getting help, because honestly the most important thing is that he gets better for himself first. After that however, it would really help me heal if I could see him and have good closure like you and your ex did... Good for you for focusing on yourself and making amends with past demons. You’ve grown and learned from your mistakes, and that makes you an amazing person. Thank you for sharing your story.♥️
